title: 第二章 李火旺
content_zh:
“呼，终于回来了。”松了一口气的李火旺对着床头麦克风呼喊起来。
没过一会，他的主治医师托着一个白色平板带着护士从病房门口走了进来。
“小李，感觉如何？这一次的幻觉有什么新的变化？”医师坐在凳子上，十分的和蔼地问道。
“还是同样的环境，我干着相同的事情。只不过这一次癞子头师傅当着我的面前，十分残忍的杀了一个人还把她炼丹。”李火旺详细的述说着自己在幻觉中看到的一切。
“嗯嗯。”主治医生一边点头一边用手指在平板上迅速敲打记录。
李火旺思索了一会后，有些犹豫的问道：“医生，这不同的幻觉代表着什么呢？对我的内心跟心理而言，包含着什么含义？”
“不，你不要关心这些，你更应该关心幻觉每一次的长度，以及精神稳定状况。”医生摇头否定了李火旺的说法。
“既然是幻觉，那就一定要去了。”
“你只要每次陷入幻觉，都按照那边的逻辑思维行动，再配合本院的治疗，很快就能治好你的。”
李火旺听到这话，心中顿时一紧，这关系到自己能否尽快出院，可千万不能马虎。
紧接着医生还不忘给自己的患者加油打气。
“其实现在你已经很好了，刚来的时候你连现实跟幻想都分不清，以后都会好起来的，继续保持，加油。”
两人交谈的时候，就听到病房的门口传来轻盈的脚步声。
两人同时闻声望去，只见一位身上穿着高领黑色毛衣的少女，偷偷的向着里面看。
少女看起年龄十六七岁，刚好是含苞待放最美好的年华，
她皮肤白皙如玉，乌黑的头发瀑布般垂直地披在肩上。如同花骨朵张开的她是如此的美好。
看着两位青年欲言又止的样子，主治医生很知趣的呵呵笑了一下，他用手指轻轻一推鼻子上的眼镜，转身向着门口走去。
“我那边还有事，你们先忙。对了，小李啊，记得等会儿按时把药吃了。”
医生刚离开，少女就走了进来，两人相视一笑，李火旺顿时感到心中甜丝丝的，心中对自己疾病的顾虑迅速抛之脑后。
“别笑了，笑起来真丑，你看我给你带来了什么？老师们亲自布置的复习功课！”面带狡黠的少女从身后拿出一个帆布挎包。

听到这话，李火旺的脸上顿时跨了来，“娜娜，好歹我们从小玩到大，你就是这么报复我吗？”
名叫杨娜的女孩子转身关好门，又拿出一个小巧的掌上游戏机，得意的晃了晃。“还有这个啦~嘻嘻，乖，叫声姐姐，我就给你。”
“姐！你是我亲姐。”李火旺激动的冲上去，抢过对方手中的游戏机。
天天憋在精神病院里太无聊了，没有疯都快要憋疯了。
“你少玩点，记得写作业啊。”杨娜侧坐在床边，对着正在开机的李火旺嘱咐到。
“嗯嗯嗯。”李火旺的注意力都集中在掌机屏幕上。
纤细白皙的手指掐着他身上的蓝白病服，依恋的地扯了扯，“喂，你别忘了，你答应过我什么。”
李火旺手一停，仰头看向了她，脸上忽然变得十分的认真。“嗯，我们说好的，要会考同一所大学的。”
杨娜被看得有些羞涩的垂下脑袋，声音变得如同蚊子般细。“嗯，好好治病，我等你.....”
李火旺忽然伸手一拽，如同宝贝般小心翼翼地搂在自己怀里。
脸上绯红的杨娜没有挣扎，只是闭上眼睛悄咪咪地说了一句大色狼。
两人并没有做什么，热恋的两人仅仅只是抱在一起，就感觉到很开心了。
两人温存了好一会后，杨娜就要离开了，毕竟她是高三的最关键的时期，能挤出半天时间来已经是很宝贵了。
虽然每次都很短，但是对于李火旺来说，这是他苦难日子里的一道曙光。
“我送你到院门口吧。”穿着蓝白条纹病服的李火旺掀开被子，穿起医院专用白色拖鞋。
刚跟着杨娜向着门口走去，却总感觉到哪里有点不对劲，赫然发现幻觉中，自己用来捣药的捣药罐就放在旁边床头桌上。
李火旺的身体顿时猛地一颤后退两步，可等再次定神一看，发现那捣药罐已经变成了自己吃饭的饭盒。
“怎么，你没事吧？”看到对方应激的举动，杨娜脸上露出一丝担忧。
看到对方脸上的担心，李火旺马上嬉皮笑脸起来。“哈哈，怎么样被我吓到了吧？”
杨娜气得皱起眉头鼓着腮帮子，伸手用力向着他腰间的细肉掐去。“都多大了，还当自己是小孩子吗？还干怎么幼稚的事情。”

“别生气啊，我就是想让你开心开心。”李火旺伸手想要牵住对方的手，却被对方直接甩开。
不过在甩开几次后，最终两人的手还是牵在了一起。
院子里正在晒太阳的其他患者看到这一幕，纷纷地露出了祥和笑容，如此青涩纯洁的爱情是多么美好。
虽然走的很慢，可最终还是到头了，杨娜站在医院大门口依依不舍地看着李火旺。“下个礼拜我还再来看你，你要在里面好好的哦。”
“要不你下个星期别来了，我知道现在学习压力很重，总共每个星期就半天的休息时间，还要浪费在我这里。”
杨娜抬起均匀的小腿，在李火旺那医院拖鞋上轻轻踩了一脚，纤细的秀眉轻轻碰在一起。
“学渣，不要随便以己度人好不好，我的排名就从来没掉过前三，哪有什么学习压力。”
“啊~”李火旺用手捂住自己的心脏，装出满脸的痛苦。“扎心了，妹子。”
杨娜被他逗得咯咯直笑，举起拳头在他身上轻轻的捶了一下后，转身如同小鹿般向着院门对面的公交站台跑去。
一直看到自己小女朋友的乘坐的那辆公交车彻底消失，李火旺脸上的笑容也逐渐消失，回想到刚刚看到的东西，忧心忡忡地向着医生办公室走去。
一小时后，躺在床上翻来覆去睡不着的李火旺烦躁思索着他跟杨娜的未来，一旁的桌子上是医生治疗新症状的新药。
白天那个捣药罐还有杨娜的笑容不断的在他脑海中轮换，
“如果病情加重了，我高考前出不了院怎么办？那我就无法跟杨娜考同一所大学了。”
虽然呆在这里面，但是李火旺明白外面的流言蜚语，自己这样的在街坊邻居眼里就是彻头彻尾的疯子。
而面对自己这样一个疯子，在入院前一天，作为青梅竹马的杨娜却主动表白，她对自己的情感一切尽在不言中。
对方是个好女孩，作为男人的自己不想辜负对方。
“不应该啊，我这些日子里完全按医嘱了，怎么病情还会加重呢？难道又要转院吗？这已经是第三家了。”
“李医生应该没问题吧，他是老爸找到的最好的医生了。”
这些烦心事越想越烦，最终他索性鲤鱼打挺般直接做了起来，把杨娜的书跟卷子都倒了出来，开始学习起来。
他想要用这些复杂生涩的知识冲淡心中的挥之不去的担忧。

李火旺继续写着作业，写着写着，不知不觉中已经到了深夜。
就在他刚完成一张英语试卷时，用力伸了一个懒腰后，用手指揉了揉发胀的太阳穴。
“哈~几点了？应该很晚了吧？”李火旺穿上拖鞋就准备上完厕所回来睡觉。
就在他哈切连天的向着门口走去的时候，胸口挠痒的右手忽然一停，李火旺感觉到自己胸口怪怪的。
李火旺拉开衣领一看，发现一摊黑褐色的东西软趴趴的趴在自己胸口，
那莫名有些熟悉的颜色，让他脑海中一个念头从中闪过。
李火旺用手指轻沾了一下放进自己的嘴里。那苦涩中丝丝甜味让他的瞳孔微微一缩，
这是之前那位幻境中的死去的傻子师姐给自己的糖块！幻境中的东西居然出现在现实了！
content_en:
"Huh, I'm finally back." Li Huowang breathed a sigh of relief and shouted into the bedside microphone.
After a while, his attending physician walked in from the ward door with a nurse and a white tablet.
"Xiao Li, how do you feel? What's new about the hallucination this time?" The doctor sat on the stool and asked very kindly.
"It's still the same environment, and I'm doing the same thing. It's just that this time Master Leizitou killed a person very cruelly in front of me and made her an elixir." Li Huowang described in detail everything he saw in the hallucination.
"Yeah." The attending doctor nodded and quickly tapped the record on the tablet with his fingers.
After thinking for a while, Li Huowang asked hesitantly: "Doctor, what do these different hallucinations mean? What do they mean to my heart and psychology?"
"No, you don't care about these. You should care more about the length of each hallucination and the mental stability." The doctor shook his head and rejected Li Huowang's statement.
"Since it's an illusion, you must go."
"As long as you act according to the logical thinking there every time you fall into hallucinations, and cooperate with the treatment of this hospital, you will be cured soon."
When Li Huowang heard this, his heart suddenly tightened. This was related to whether he could be discharged from the hospital as soon as possible, so he must not be careless.
Immediately afterwards, the doctor did not forget to cheer for his patient.
"Actually, you are doing very well now. When you first came here, you couldn't even tell the difference between reality and fantasy. You will get better in the future. Keep up the good work."
While the two were talking, they heard light footsteps coming from the door of the ward.
The two of them heard the sound and went out at the same time, only to see a girl wearing a turtleneck black sweater secretly looking inside.
The girl looked to be sixteen or seventeen years old, just in her prime years when she was about to bloom.
Her skin is as fair as jade, and her black hair cascades vertically over her shoulders. She is so beautiful when she opens like a flower.
Seeing the two young men hesitating to speak, the attending doctor chuckled knowingly. He gently pushed the glasses on his nose with his fingers, turned around and walked towards the door.
"I still have something to do over there, so you guys should be busy first. By the way, Xiao Li, remember to take the medicine on time later."
As soon as the doctor left, the girl walked in. The two looked at each other and smiled. Li Huowang suddenly felt sweet in his heart, and his worries about his disease were quickly forgotten.
"Stop laughing, you look so ugly when you smile. Look what I brought you? Review homework assigned by the teachers themselves!" The sly-looking girl took out a canvas satchel from behind.
Hearing this, Li Huowang's face suddenly crossed, "Nana, after all, we have been playing together since childhood. Is this how you retaliate against me?"
The girl named Yang Na turned around and closed the door, then took out a small handheld game console and shook it proudly. "There's still this~ Hehe, be good, call me sister, and I'll give it to you."
"Sister! You are my biological sister." Li Huowang rushed forward excitedly and snatched the game console from the opponent's hand.
It's so boring to stay in a mental hospital every day. It's almost driving me crazy if I'm not crazy.
"Stop playing and remember to do your homework." Yang Na sat on the side of the bed and told Li Huowang who was turning on the phone.
"Yeah, yeah." Li Huowang's attention was focused on the screen of his handheld device.
Slender white fingers pinched the blue and white hospital gown on his body, and pulled it affectionately, "Hey, don't forget what you promised me."
Li Huowang stopped his hand and looked up at her, his face suddenly becoming very serious. "Well, we agreed that we should be able to get into the same university."
Yang Na lowered her head shyly and her voice became as thin as a mosquito. "Well, take good care of yourself and I'll wait for you..."
Li Huowang suddenly reached out and pulled her, carefully holding her in his arms like a treasure.
blush on faceYang Na didn't struggle, she just closed her eyes and whispered "big pervert".
The two of them didn't do anything. The two people who were passionately in love just hugged each other and felt very happy.
After the two warmed up for a while, Yang Na was about to leave. After all, she was in the most critical period of her senior year of high school, and it was very precious to be able to squeeze out half a day.
Although each time was short, for Li Huowang, it was a ray of light in his difficult days.
"I'll take you to the entrance of the hospital." Li Huowang, who was wearing a blue and white striped hospital uniform, lifted the quilt and put on the hospital's special white slippers.
As soon as I followed Yang Na towards the door, I always felt that something was wrong. I suddenly realized that in my hallucination, the medicine jar I used to make medicine was placed on the bedside table next to me.
Li Huowang's body suddenly trembled and he took two steps back. But when he took a closer look, he found that the potion jar had turned into a lunch box for him to eat.
"What, are you okay?" Seeing the other party's irritable behavior, Yang Na showed a trace of worry on her face.
Seeing the worry on the other person's face, Li Huowang immediately smiled playfully. "Haha, why are you scared by me?"
Yang Na frowned in anger, puffed out her cheeks, stretched out her hand and pinched the thin flesh of his waist. "How old are you? Do you still think you are a child? Are you still doing such childish things?"
"Don't be angry, I just want to make you happy." Li Huowang reached out to hold the other person's hand, but was thrown away by the other person.
But after shaking off several times, the two finally held hands together.
When the other patients who were basking in the sun in the yard saw this scene, they all showed peaceful smiles. Such young and pure love is so beautiful.
Although the walk was very slow, it finally came to an end. Yang Na stood at the gate of the hospital and looked at Li Huowang reluctantly. "I'll come see you again next week. You need to be well in there."
"Why don't you come here next week? I know that there is a lot of pressure to study now. In total, you only have half a day of rest every week, and you still have to waste it with me."
Yang Na raised her even calves and stepped lightly on Li Huowang's hospital slippers, and her slender eyebrows touched lightly.
"You're a scumbag, don't judge others by yourself, okay? My ranking has never fallen below the top three, so there's no pressure to study."
"Ah~" Li Huowang covered his heart with his hand, pretending to be in pain. "It hurts my heart, sister."
Yang Na was amused by him and giggled. She raised her fist and punched him lightly, then turned around and ran towards the bus stop opposite the courtyard gate like a deer.
Until he saw that the bus his little girlfriend was riding on had completely disappeared, the smile on Li Huowang's face gradually disappeared. Thinking back to what he had just seen, he walked towards the doctor's office worriedly.
An hour later, Li Huowang was lying on the bed, tossing and turning, unable to sleep, thinking irritably about his future with Yang Na. On the table next to him was the doctor's new medicine to treat new symptoms.
The medicine jar and Yang Na's smile kept rotating in his mind during the day.
"What if the condition worsens and I can't leave the hospital before the college entrance examination? Then I won't be able to enter the same university as Yang Na."
Although he stayed here, Li Huowang understood the rumors outside. He was a complete lunatic in the eyes of his neighbors.
Faced with a lunatic like herself, Yang Na, a childhood sweetheart, took the initiative to confess her feelings for him the day before he was admitted to the hospital.
The other person is a good girl, and as a man, I don’t want to let the other person down.
"It shouldn't be. I've been following the doctor's orders these days, so why is my condition getting worse? Do I need to be transferred to another hospital? This is already the third hospital."
"Dr. Li should be fine. He is the best doctor dad has found."
The more he thought about these troublesome things, the more troublesome he became. In the end, he simply started doing it like a carp, andYang Na poured out her books and papers and started studying.
He wanted to use this complicated and unfamiliar knowledge to dilute the lingering worries in his heart.
Li Huowang continued to write homework, writing and writing, and it was late at night before he knew it.
Just when he finished an English test paper, he stretched hard and rubbed his swollen temples with his fingers.
"Ha~ what time is it? It must be very late, right?" Li Huowang put on his slippers and prepared to go to the toilet and come back to sleep.
Just as he was walking towards the door in a hurry, the right hand that was scratching his chest suddenly stopped, and Li Huowang felt a strange feeling in his chest.
Li Huowang opened his collar and took a look, and found a pool of dark brown stuff lying softly on his chest.
The inexplicably familiar color made an idea flash through his mind.
Li Huowang lightly touched it with his finger and put it into his mouth. The hint of sweetness in the bitterness made his pupils shrink slightly,
This is the candy bar given to me by the dead idiot senior sister in the illusion! Things in the fantasy actually appear in reality!
